properties.name: Chatham Emergency Services — EMS (countywide 911 ambulance)

game.notes: The exclusive countywide 911 ALS ambulance provider — every transport in Chatham County is CES. Build rescue/ambulance stations to mirror. Exact fleet size not publicly enumerated.

properties.significance: Community-owned nonprofit; the sole 911 emergency ambulance service for all of Chatham County (~75,000 EMS calls/yr, CAAS-accredited, tactical-medic and infectious-disease transport teams). Operates a single citywide catalog entry here.

properties.name: Georgia Ports Authority Police Department

game.notes: State-agency police securing the Port of Savannah (Garden City Terminal, the largest single-terminal container facility in North America). No Georgia State Patrol post lies inside Chatham County (nearest is Post 42 in Rincon).

properties.significance: POST-certified state-agency police force securing the Port of Savannah. Stands in for state law-enforcement presence, as the nearest Georgia State Patrol post (Post 42) is in Rincon, outside the county.

properties.name: CBP / HSI — Port of Savannah

game.notes: CBP port-of-entry presence for the Port of Savannah; ICE Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) also operates a Savannah office working port/cargo cases (no separate public street address).

properties.significance: Federal border/customs enforcement at one of the busiest container ports in the U.S.; HSI conducts port-related investigations in the area.

sources.title: HSI operations at the Port of Savannah — ICE

properties.name: Memorial Health University Medical Center

attributes.childrens_hospital: Dwaine & Cynthia Willett Children’s Hospital of Savannah

game.notes: The region’s only Level I trauma center and only children’s hospital — destination for the most critical patients. Top-priority hospital build. Helipad not confirmed in a citable public source.

properties.significance: Southeast Georgia’s only ACS-verified Level I trauma center; comprehensive stroke center, Level I cardiac center, and the region’s only children’s hospital. Owned by HCA Healthcare.

sources.title: Memorial Health Level I trauma center — WTOC

properties.name: Candler Hospital

game.notes: Full ED but not a trauma center — a good general-patient destination. One of the two St. Joseph’s/Candler anchor hospitals.

properties.significance: 384-bed acute-care hospital with an emergency department; hosts the Mary Telfair Women’s Hospital and the Lewis Cancer & Research Pavilion. Founded 1804.

properties.name: St. Joseph’s Hospital

game.notes: Full ED with a helipad and the region’s main open-heart program. Good southside hospital destination.

properties.significance: Southside acute-care hospital with an emergency department, air-ambulance helipad, and The Heart Hospital (region’s primary cardiovascular/open-heart program).

properties.name: Georgia Regional Hospital at Savannah

agency.name: Georgia Dept. of Behavioral Health & Developmental Disabilities

game.notes: State psychiatric hospital (no general ED) — relevant for behavioral-health / psych-transport missions rather than trauma.

properties.significance: State-run psychiatric hospital; a destination for behavioral-health patients, not general emergencies.

sources.title: Georgia Regional Hospital at Savannah — DBHDD

properties.name: Chatham County Detention Center

game.notes: Large county jail (booking + pretrial + short sentences) run by the Sheriff. Supports prisoner-transport and jail-disturbance missions. Capacity figures vary by source (~1,650–2,433 design; ~2,000 average population).

properties.significance: The county’s primary jail, operated by the Chatham County Sheriff’s Office; one of the larger detention centers in coastal Georgia.

properties.name: Savannah Regional Youth Detention Center

game.notes: State juvenile detention center. Capacity/security not publicly documented (left null rather than guessed).

properties.significance: State-run juvenile detention center serving Chatham, Effingham and McIntosh counties; adjacent to the adult jail.

sources.title: Savannah RYDC — Georgia Dept. of Juvenile Justice

properties.name: Coastal State Prison

game.notes: State medium-security prison (~1,836 beds, adult male). Supports prisoner-transport and prison-disturbance missions.

properties.significance: Georgia DOC medium-security state prison for adult male felons; opened 1981, ~1,836 beds.

sources.title: Coastal State Prison — Georgia Dept. of Corrections

properties.name: Sapp’s Wrecker Service

game.notes: Long-established local wrecker/impound operator associated with the police tow rotation. Contract status and fleet not authoritatively confirmed — low confidence.

properties.significance: Representative heavy-recovery/impound operator; public tow-rotation data for the county is sparse, so this is one documented example rather than an exhaustive list.

properties.name: Chatham Emergency Management Agency (CEMA) / EOC

game.notes: County Emergency Operations Center / coordination hub. The primary 911 PSAP is run by Chatham County Emergency Communications (except Tybee Island, which runs its own) — its physical address is not publicly documented, so the EOC is mapped here as the dispatch/coordination anchor.

properties.significance: Coordinates countywide emergency management and hosts the primary Emergency Operations Center on Bull Street.

properties.name: U.S. Coast Guard Station Tybee

game.notes: Small-boat search-and-rescue / law-enforcement station guarding the Savannah River entrance. Coordinates approximate (Cockspur Island).

properties.significance: One of only two Coast Guard small-boat stations in Georgia; covers the Savannah River mouth and coastal waters with a 45-ft Response Boat–Medium.

sources.title: Cockspur Island / USCG Station Tybee — Wikipedia

properties.name: Coast Guard Air Station Savannah

game.notes: Coast Guard air search-and-rescue base flying MH-65 Dolphin helicopters from Hunter Army Airfield.

properties.significance: Provides 24/7 rotary-wing search-and-rescue and law-enforcement air support for the Georgia/South Carolina coast (~450 miles of shoreline) with five MH-65 Dolphin helicopters.

sources.title: Coast Guard Air Station Savannah — Wikipedia
CGAS Savannah at Hunter Army Airfield — army.mil
